req.title: Task description optional
req.statement: The system shall accept POST /tasks/ payloads without a description field.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the task description field is optional when creating a task. Therefore, we need to test that the system correctly handles requests both with and without the description field. We also need to ensure that the system responds appropriately to invalid requests, such as those missing required fields.

tests.name: test_create_task_without_description
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that includes only the title and completed fields.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
The description field in the response payload is null.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "Test Task", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "Test Task"
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
assert response.json()["description"] is None

tests.name: test_create_task_missing_title
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that includes only the completed field.
expected: The response payload contains an error message indicating that the title field is required.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "field required"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_max_title_length
preconditions: The FastAPI app is running and accessible.
The database is initialized and empty.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a payload that includes a title of maximum allowed length (100 characters) and a completed field.
expected: The response payload contains the task with the correct title and completed status.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "T" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == max_length_title
assert response.json()["completed"] is False
